directionalDiagnostic.method: Correlation of smoothed GPU temporal differences over 0–0.75 s and 4–4.75 s. Diagnostic evidence only; inspect animation for naturalness.

photographicDriftDiagnostic.method: Direct correlation of smoothed photographic luminance over four-second intervals, including both sides of the former 22-second reset and the late spatial texture seam. Positive displacement is rightward. Every interval must have rightward evidence in at least two of its three bands.

halfStepDiagnostic.method: Actual t+0.025 frame minus the linear midpoint of t and t+0.05 frames. Residuals identify abrupt temporal changes independently of high-contrast photographic edges.
